Container.Name: kenshi-online-server
Container.Overview: Kenshi-Online dedicated server. Up to 16 players, ENet over UDP. Persists world saves under /data. Runs as PUID/PGID for Unraid-friendly appdata ownership.

Config.Name: Game port (UDP)
Config.Description: ENet game traffic. Forward this on your router if hosting on the public internet, or use a Tailscale sidecar.

Config.Name: Master server port (UDP, optional)
Config.Description: Server browser registry. Only needed if you self-host the master server (most people don't).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: World saves and server.json. The container writes a default server.json here on first run.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID the server runs as. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID the server runs as. Unraid default: 100 (users).
